summary: Flathead County, MT tower: a 1929 crow's nest, then a 40-foot pole L-4 tower in 1934; named staff 1940-1967; destroyed 1976 per firelookout.com. No source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Named staff, the 1937 training item, the 1951 cab description and the 1953 fire all come from newspaper items the Forest Lookouts page quotes (Daily Inter Lake, The Inter Lake, The Flathead Courier); the original papers were not opened. The end date is firelookout.com only ('Destroyed 1976'); the Forest Lookouts page gives an undated 'Removed' label, so the story reports both without choosing. The 1958 surname is spelled Schlitz on firelookout.com and Schiltz on the Forest Lookouts page; the story uses Schlitz and notes the variant. The 1975 Kootenai bid on Sunday Mountain concerns a different tower and was not used. The brief's height of 4.3 m appears to be the 14-foot cab width; see corrections. Brief access 'unknown' is left out of facts. No photo found.
